 Thanksgiving meal deals 2026: Cracker Barrel, Pizza Hut, Target, and more
 Make your holiday feast less stressful. 
  By 
 Christina Buff 
 Christina Buff 
 Christina Buff is a Nashville-based freelance writer for who covers shopping with a splash of entertainment. If you’re ever wondering what streaming service you need to watch something (and the cheapest way to sign up for it), she’s your girl.

 Deal pricing and availability subject to change after time of publication.
 Learn more about how we select deals .
 Thanksgiving doesn't have to be a stressful holiday. Thanks to several chain restaurants and retailers, you can save some time, effort, and money this year on your meal. We've rounded up a handful of places you can grab all the ingredients you need at a discount or a pre-made meal for a locked-in price. There's no shame in grabbing a pre-made Thanksgiving feast, BTW. 
 Check out some of our favorite Thanksgiving 2026 meal deals below:
 Bob Evans
 Choose from several pre-made Thanksgiving meals at Bob Evans, including the Ham Farmhoue Feast that feeds four for $94.99 or the Turkey Farmhouse Feast that feeds four for $104.99.
 Cracker Barrel
 Cracker Barrel's Thanksgiving Heat & Serve Feast feeds up to 10 people for just $144.99 and includes two oven-roasted turkey breasts, cornbread dressing, gravy, cranberry relish, sweet potato casserole, and more.
 Denny's
 Denny's is bringing back its limited-time Turkey Bundle , which includes a carved turkey breast, bread stuffing, mashed potatoes, gravy, and cranberry sauce. Order from Denny's website for participating locations between Nov. 20 and Nov. 25.

 Pizza Hut
 Customers can get a limited-time "Triple Treat Box" for just $21.99, which includes two medium, two-topping pizzas, breadsticks, and cinnamon sticks. The deal runs through Dec. 28.
 Popeyes
 Popeyes' Cajun Turkey is back for another year and starts at $54.99 for pickup only.

 Ruth's Chris Steak House
 Ruth's Chris Steak House is offering a $196 heat-and-serve Thanksgiving feast this year. Orders are open until November 20. 
 Target
 A Thanksgiving meal for six at Target is just $30 and includes a whole turkey, potatoes, green beans, gravy, and more. 
 Walmart
 Walmart's Thanksgiving meal deal includes a whole turkey, plus almost all the ingredients you need to make your side dishes this holiday season, all for just $35. Walmart estimates the meal should serve 10 and it's valid through Dec. 24.

 Christina received a B.S. in Business Communication (concentration in writing) from Stevenson University and began her professional journey writing and editing press releases. Since then, she’s written content for a marketing agency, blogged for celebrities, and covered local news, politics, women’s lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and just about everything in between for various publications.
 When she’s not writing, she’s probably enjoying live music, studying human design, or embroidering and upcycling clothes. You can follow her on Instagram at @touchinfinity .
